  • 日本語名: よみエッチ！ ～本好きで妄想系な先輩と、男好きで小悪魔系な先生、でもって僕～
  • 英語名: Yomi Ecchi! Honzuki de Mousou Kei na Senpai to, Otokozuki de Koakuma Kei na Sensei, Demotte Boku

あらすじ

Shougo is a male student who is interested in sex at his age. But he is a virgin. He uses pornography he borrows from his best friend, and handles his excessive sexual desire on his own.

Shougo has been in love with Shouko the older sister of Marina, his childhood friend. He’s been in love with her the moment he saw her all those years back. In order to be as close as possible to Shouko, who loves to read, Shougo started reading books himself.

item.title: Ruriiro no Yuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ail
  • 発売日: 1997-03-07
  • スコア: 6.15/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 瑠璃色の雪 ～るりいろのゆき～
  • 英語名: Ruriiro no Yuki

あらすじ

The protagonist of the game is a high school student who has lost his parents in a car accident. Living with foster parents was difficult, and he decided to rent the room in the house that once belonged to his real parents, feeling that their spirits will become closer to him that way. However, shortly thereafter the boy started seeing strange dreams. Upon his arrival he discovered a jar in a hole underneath the floor in his room, and that jar miraculously produced a young woman named Ruri (which means “lapis lazuli”), who becomes a part of his life in a way he would never expect.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ail
  • 発売日: 1995-04-15
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: デュアルソウル
  • 英語名: Dual Soul

あらすじ

Gush is a treasure hunter. He is searching for the Gomalie ruins at the request of Evonos Church with three friends. As he was leaving the ruins he got caught in the trap and got multiple spear piercing wounds. He should have died but he awoke at the bed. His appearance changed drastically as he took the form of Edner who fell from the roof at the same time. He is sentenced to live as Edner by the church bishop. Then suspicious events start to happen one by one…
